remarks: Charming ranch-style home offering comfortable, easy one-level living in a desirable Norwalk location. The main level features a light-filled living room and an eat-in kitchen with ample space for casual dining. Three well-proportioned bedrooms and a full bath complete the primary living area. The lower level provides additional versatile living space, including a spacious family room, full bathroom, and dedicated laundry area. With direct walkout access to the backyard and entry to the garage, this level offers excellent flexibility for recreation, guests, or a home office. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and major commuting routes, this home presents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy all that Norwalk has to offer.
